list: Donations are currently being accepted for the Christmas Shoeboxes through the month of August. Our goal is 150 shoeboxes.

Women on Mission will meet on Monday, August 10 at 6:00 PM in the Lewis Fellowship Hall. Margaret Davidson will present the program, and Tracey Kidd will provide the food. All women are encouraged and invited to attend.
The next Men’s Discipleship Breakfast is Saturday, August 22 at 8:00 AM, and will be hosted by Mark Deaton. All men are encouraged to attend and invite a friend.
The next quarterly business meeting will be held on Sunday, September 6th after the morning worship service.
Upcoming preachers: Andrew Dyer - August 9 & 23 || Camron Hyde - August 16 || Jared Styles - August 30 through September

fighterVerse.text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
